changes.reason: Frozen capacity shows that up to 5.6786 eV, at most 4 states exist across all k-points, exactly matching num_wann = 4. The 5th band begins at 5.68 eV. Raising dis_froz_max from 2.0 eV to 5.6 eV freezes the entire 4-band manifold across the energy range weighted by the eta2 metric (evaluated at mu = E_F + 2 eV), continuing the substantial improvement seen in attempt 3.
Sets the projectability threshold high so that states above 5.6 eV are not frozen by projectability, avoiding any k-point holding more frozen states than num_wann.

diagnosis: The construction fails only on band_interpolation_eta2 (52.06 meV vs limit 20 meV), which measures interpolation fidelity on a high-symmetry path using Fermi-Dirac weighting at E_F + 2 eV (mu = 3.555 eV). In attempt 4, dis_froz_max was set to 2.0 eV with dis_proj_max = 0.85. However, band_character shows that the conduction states in the [-4, 6] eV window have negligible projection onto the Na pseudo-atomic p orbitals (Na p: 0.021), meaning projectability cannot freeze these free-electron-like bands. Consequently, bands 5-8 above 2.0 eV were unconstrained in attempt 4, leading to large interpolation errors (up to ~150 meV) in the 1.7-3.5 eV range. In attempt 3, raising dis_froz_max to 5.0 eV brought eta2 down from 51.17 to 34.11 meV. frozen_capacity confirms that up to 5.6786 eV, the number of states at any k-point does not exceed 4 (with band 9 only appearing at 5.68 eV). Raising dis_froz_max further to 5.6 eV, with dis_proj_max = 0.99 to prevent accidental freezing above the window, will enforce exact subspace agreement across the entire 4-band manifold.

band_interpolation_eta2.note: eta_2 = 12.83 meV at mu = E_F(scf) + 2 = 3.555 eV over 270 path k-points and 4 bands
band_interpolation_eta2.insulator_rule: no band crosses E_F on the mesh and gap >= sigma = 0.1 eV
